footer.blurb: Vita connects you with verified doctors, clinics, and telehealth — calm, clear, and trustworthy.

hero.headline: Vita
hero.subhead: Leading medical clinics across the Kingdom — transparent packages, elite consultants, and easy booking.

home.aboutTrustBody: A network of accredited clinics with board-certified specialists — from dental and dermatology to hair restoration and general medicine. Clear prices, flexible payment, and care you can trust.
home.installmentBody: Split your treatment into easy monthly installments — approved in minutes with our partner banks.
home.servicesSub: Four clear pathways to the care you need — dental, skin & laser, medical, and hair.
home.pillarDentalLine: Implants, whitening, orthodontics, and smile makeovers.
home.pillarDermLine: Skin treatments, laser, and aesthetic procedures.
home.pillarMedicalLine: General practice, checkups, and specialist consultations.
home.pillarHairLine: Hair restoration, plasma therapy, and scalp wellness.
home.offersSub: Browse seasonal deals on dental, skin, hair, and medical care — book in one tap.
home.campaignBody: Restore your confidence with advanced FUE hair transplant or transform your smile with implant and whitening packages — starting from clear SAR prices.
home.doctorsSub: An elite team across clinics — experience a calm, complete care journey.
home.branchesSub: Choose a city to see providers and book where it suits you.
home.featuredSub: Verified doctors and clinics patients are booking right now.
home.specialtiesSub: Browse by medical specialty to find the right provider for your needs.
home.specialtyGeneralLine: Primary care, check-ups, and everyday health concerns.
home.specialtyCardiologyLine: Heart health, diagnostics, and preventive cardiovascular care.
home.specialtyDermatologyLine: Skin, hair, and cosmetic dermatology with trusted specialists.
home.specialtyPediatricsLine: Gentle, expert care for infants, children, and adolescents.
home.specialtyOrthopedicsLine: Bones, joints, sports injuries, and mobility support.
home.specialtyMentalLine: Counseling, psychiatry, and emotional wellness support.
home.processSub: From search to appointment — simple, transparent, and patient-first.
home.step1Body: Pick a department or filter by specialty, city, and care mode.
home.step2Body: Review packages, doctors, and clinics — save favorites to revisit.
home.step3Body: Message the provider to confirm an in-person, telehealth, or home visit.
home.telehealthSub: Video consultations with verified providers — secure and convenient.
home.testimonialsSub: Real experiences from people who found care through Vita.
home.t1Quote: Everything felt organized — from reception to the specialist. Clear pricing and a calm clinic experience.
home.t2Quote: Listing my clinic took minutes. Patients reach out with clear questions and book the same day.
home.t3Quote: I compared pediatricians, saved my favorites, and booked a visit before the weekend.
home.faqSub: Clear answers about visits, packages, branches, and telehealth — so you can book with confidence.
home.faqHelpBody: Our care coordinators can guide you to the right specialty and branch.
home.faq1Q: How do I book an appointment at Vita?
home.faq1A: Choose a package or specialty, then book from the listing or the header button. A coordinator confirms your preferred branch and time.
home.faq2A: Listed prices are transparent starting packages in SAR. Your consultant may adjust the plan after assessment if your case needs a different protocol.
home.faq3Q: Which cities and branches do you cover?
home.faq3A: We currently serve Riyadh, Jeddah, Khobar, and Dammam, with telehealth available remotely for selected consultations.
home.faq4Q: Can I start with a telehealth visit?
home.faq4A: Yes. Many specialties offer secure video consultations first, then an in-clinic follow-up when treatment needs to continue on site.
home.ctaBandBody: Find a clinic, compare offers, and connect with a specialist today.

replies.book: You can book from Packages or tap Book your appointment in the header. Prefer WhatsApp? Use the green button.
replies.branch: We serve Riyadh, Jeddah, Khobar, and Dammam. Open Branches on the home page for maps and hours.
replies.offers: Browse Packages for transparent SAR pricing — whitening, implants, filler, laser, and more.
replies.dental: Dental packages include implants, whitening, and smile makeovers. See Dentistry under Our services.
replies.derm: Dermatology and laser packages are listed under Dermatology — fillers, Botox, and skin rejuvenation.
replies.hair: Hair transplant and scalp care packages are available with consultant assessment first.
replies.fallback: Thanks — a care coordinator can help via WhatsApp or by booking a package. What specialty are you looking for?
